def _numpy_div(a, b, replace_inf_with=1):
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
        result = np.divide(a, b)
        result[np.isinf(result)] = replace_inf_with
        result[np.isnan(result)] = replace_inf_with
    return result

def _get_numpy_array_distance(num1, num2, max_=1, use_log_scale=False,
    log_scale_similarity_threshold=0.1):

        distances = _numpy_div(np.abs(num1_float - num2_float), max_num, replace_inf_with=0)
